observations.title: queryOneShot has no production callers — background claim about request-review/request-generate is inaccurate
observations.rationale: background 節が「この経路は request-review / request-generate コマンドが使う」と述べているが、src/ 内の全 .ts ファイルを検索した結果 queryOneShot の production インポートはゼロ。request-generate は TC-013 で削除済み（prompt-skeleton-drift-guard.test.ts の TC-028 コメントで確認）、request-review は RequestReviewStep として ClaudeCodeRunner 経由で実行。受け入れ基準 3「query-one-shot 経路でも同じ 4 値が記録されることをテストで固定する」は、「QueryOneShotResult として返す（unit テスト対象）」と解釈すれば実装可能。usage.json への記録は req 4（commit-orchestrator）経由であり req 3 は戻り値レベルと解釈するのが整合的。要件や受け入れ基準の成立は妨げないが、実装前に解釈を確認することを推奨する。

observations.title: error subtype の metrics が usage.json に到達しない可能性
observations.rationale: appendInvocation は applySuccessPostPersistEffects（success path のみ）から呼ばれる。agent-runner.ts の error 分岐（810-824）は早期 return しており commit-orchestrator を経由しないため、error subtype から抽出した metrics は AgentRunResult に乗るが usage.json には記録されない可能性がある。受け入れ基準 2「success / error 双方の subtype について検証する」が「抽出のテスト（adapter 単体テスト）」なのか「usage.json への記録テスト」なのかが曖昧。素直に読めば前者（adapter テスト = 抽出検証）が意図と解せるため、ブロッキングではない。

toolResult.reason:
Designed the agent-invocation-metrics change and wrote design.md, spec.md, tasks.md under specrunner/changes/agent-invocation-metrics/ on branch feat/agent-invocation-metrics-f94950fe.

Design summary (verified against current code):
- D1: Add shared type AgentInvocationMetrics (numTurns/durationMs/durationApiMs/totalCostUsd, all optional) on src/core/port/agent-runner.ts; add invocationMetrics? to AgentRunResult; add flat optional metrics fields (with doc comments) to CommandInvocation (src/core/usage/types.ts).
- D2: Adapter (agent-runner.ts) extracts the 4 metrics from the same result message for BOTH success (:827-844 → baseResult :1029-1041) and error subtype (:810-825) via a defensive `typeof number` helper so missing fields stay undefined (never 0/null). mergeFollowUpResult spreads baseResult so metrics survive.
- D3: Metrics ride the existing appendInvocation path — executor.ts:508-520 threads runResult.invocationMetrics into StepExecutionResult; commit-orchestrator applySuccessPostPersistEffects spreads them into the CommandInvocation. Existing gate (modelUsage present) unchanged; error-subtype metrics are carried on AgentRunResult but not persisted (success-only recording), flagged as an explicit scope boundary + Open Question.
- D4: query-one-shot repurposes the turnCount placeholder into numTurns + 3 metrics (success only; zero production callers).
- D5: usage-show appends metrics when present, omits/"-" otherwise.
- D6: job-stats deriveRunStat prefers per-invocation totalCostUsd (measured), falls back to computeCostUsd (estimated) only when absent — no double counting; adds costBasis (measured/estimated/mixed/null). Unknown-model-with-totalCostUsd no longer silently dropped.
- D7: run-level turn total (turns), null when no invocation has numTurns.
- D8 (key AC #10 mechanism): new JobStatRow fields turns/costBasis are OPTIONAL so existing hand-built row literals in job-stats.test.ts still typecheck and TC-JSTATS-024/025 exact-key snapshots stay green unchanged, while deriveRunStat always populates them for real output. Summary schema left unchanged.

tasks.md: T-01 types → T-02 adapter extraction (success+error) / T-03 one-shot → T-04 executor+commit-orchestrator wiring → T-05 usage show / T-06 job stats → T-07 backward-compat + acceptance fixation + full verify. Each acceptance criterion 1–10 is mapped to a task.

One noted deviation flagged prominently (not silently applied): query-one-shot.test.ts "turnCount is undefined" placeholder test will be updated (outside AC #10's usage/job-stats protection scope) because turnCount is repurposed to numTurns.
